# sh-list-report

**Purpose:** One report or document in a list. No side padding — the card or sheet insets it. Part of sh-list — place sh-list and pick its Type; edit these options under Row.

**State:** Open (chevron) · Download (Premium viewer) · Premium lock (free viewer: readable, gold lock) · Locked (greyed, grey lock) · Upgrade (premium soft band + Upgrade button that leads a locked group; keeps its 16 padding).

Core · 5 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=3322-75526) (node `3322:75526`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### State=Open

Report row, open: tap to view the report.

### State=Download

Report row, Premium viewer: report ready to download.

### State=Premium lock

Report row, free viewer on the profile: readable title and line, gold lock — unlock with Premium.

### State=Locked

Report row, free viewer in a sheet: greyed title, grey lock — content not open yet.

### State=Upgrade

Report row, upgrade strip: premium soft band with one line and the Upgrade button — leads a locked report group.

## Anatomy

Layer tree of `State=Open`. Nested components are shown by name; their internals live in their own blueprint.

- root — column
  - Row — row · fill × hug
    - Content — column · fill × hug
      - Title row — row · fill × hug
        - Title — text "Title"
        - Title icon — **sh-icon/information-circle** (Type Line, Size 16) · hidden by default
      - Subtitle — text "Subtitle"
    - Trailing — row · hug × hug
      - Trailing icon — **sh-icon/arrow-right-01** (Type Line, Size 20)
  - Divider — **sh-divider** (Orientation Horizontal, Type Soft) · hidden by default
